entries.title: Usage sharing fix
entries.summary: The sharing prompt is back, with one switch for activity and device details.

changes.title: Usage sharing
changes.description: Choose Enable sharing or Later when you open the update.
details: Use one switch for activity and device details.
Enable sharing again if the previous version blocked it.

entries.title: Noji cards and more voices
entries.summary: Bring your flashcards into Study and choose how you listen.

changes.title: Noji flashcards
changes.description: Bring a Noji deck into Study from a CSV file. Your cards keep their original front and back.
details: Choose the front and back columns, then check every card before importing.
Edit a card or uncheck anything you do not want to bring over.
Keep your words, sentences and examples together in one deck.
Find your decks with the Noji library filter. Flip cards and listen where Japanese is available.

images.alt: The Noji import screen with a CSV deck, front and back columns and cards ready to import.
images.caption: Choose your CSV and check the cards before importing.

images.alt: Editing the front and back of a Noji card while another card is unchecked.
images.caption: Change a card or leave it out of the import.

changes.title: Voice choices
changes.description: Right-click the play button in Study to choose a voice.
details: iKnow: original audio, Mao Plain or Nise.
Noji: Mao Plain or Nise.
Keep separate choices for iKnow and Noji.

images.alt: A Noji card in Study with the voice menu open.
images.caption: Right-click the play button to choose Mao Plain or Nise.

changes.title: Optional usage sharing
changes.description: Choose whether to share extension activity to help improve Reading Helper.
details: Off until you enable it.
Optionally share GPU, driver, system and model details for troubleshooting.
Turn sharing off whenever you like.

changes.title: Study options
changes.description: Choose how you read and what you practise.
details: Keep Romaji visible on iKnow study cards.
Filter your library and practice selection by New, Weak, Learning or Strong.
Apply a dark theme to iKnow course and series pages or just the Helper panels.

changes.title: Study pages
details: A tidier settings panel on iKnow.
Clearer audio labels and separate volume for local AI voices.
Keep Reading Helper tabs open on future updates once this version is installed.
Close buttons use text instead of X icons.
Type without browser spelling underlines.
Selection menus now use matching checkmarks.

entries.title: Small interface fixes
entries.summary: A tidier course practice screen and volume slider.

changes.title: Practice and volume controls
changes.description: Two small fixes while you study.
details: Course practice fits the available space without unnecessary scrolling.
Dragging a volume slider no longer adds an extra outline.

entries.title: A tidier study space
entries.summary: A cleaner course picker and space for your notes and recordings.

changes.title: Personal learning levels
changes.description: Right-click a saved word or sentence to set its learning level.
details: Choose New, Weak, Learning or Strong.
Choose Automatic to use your practice results again.

images.alt: A saved word with the right-click menu open, showing Automatic, New, Weak, Learning and Strong.
images.caption: Right-click a saved card to choose its learning level.

changes.title: Study details
changes.description: A cleaner look while you learn.
details: A tidier Kana chart, without the extra character at the top.
A neater course picker with clearer loading and error messages.
A new Fill the gap icon.
Clearer playback controls and a focused recording view.
Full-width notes that reopen in read view, with smoother transitions.
Less automatic processing on microphone recordings.
Fill the gap now recognises the word forms used in iKnow examples.
Delete a saved note directly from its panel.
Switch between saved words and practice options without flashing.

entries.title: Your study space
entries.summary: Your library, practice and course tests in one place.

changes.title: Study workspace
changes.description: A new home for learning Japanese.
details: Keep your saved words, sentences and notes close by.
Practise with Review, Fill the gap and Listening, using your library or a full course.
Take course tests, see your answers and revisit mistakes.
Learn Hiragana and Katakana with the groups and characters you choose.
Back up your library and learning progress, and restore them on another PC.
Adjust playback volume for original audio and your recordings.

images.alt: The new Study workspace with a saved library and reading card.
images.caption: Your library and study tools in one place.

images.alt: Hiragana chart with basic, voiced and combination groups.
images.caption: Pick the characters and groups you want to practise.

changes.title: Theme menus
changes.description: One theme picker style across Reading Helper.
details: Color swatches and a checkmark make your selection clear.

entries.title: Your choice of Romaji
entries.summary: A new reading option and a home for release notes.

changes.title: Romaji style
details: Pronunciation shows particles as wa, e and o.
Available in the course toolbar, popup and Study space.

images.alt: Source spelling and particle pronunciation side by side
images.caption: Choose the reading style that helps you most.

changes.title: Changelog
changes.description: See what's changed, with pictures when helpful.

changes.title: Updates section
changes.description: Removed the extra outline after installing updates.

entries.title: Keep translations together
entries.summary: A small fix for Both languages.

changes.title: Vocabulary buttons
changes.description: Save and practice buttons now sit below English and German.

images.alt: Vocabulary buttons before and after the Both languages fix
images.caption: Both translations stay together.
